title: SupplierConfig
description: A supplier is independent of region: it manufactures goods in one country and ships them to warehouses in whichever regions order from it (a US warehouse, a CN warehouse, an EU warehouse, ...). One supplier id = one versioned, effective-dated document, keyed by supplier alone — no region/salesOrg scoping. `supplierCountry` is a single supplier-wide attribute (where the supplier itself is based). Freight, duty, and tariff are NOT supplier-wide flat numbers — they vary by which warehouse receives the shipment, so they live in `warehouses`, keyed by warehouse code. MOLV and MOQ are supplier-wide order minimums, not warehouse-specific.

supplierCountry.description: The supplier's own country — where it manufactures/is registered. Drives region logic that keys off the supplier's country (e.g. China's freight&duty branch, Americas'/India's local-vs-overseas split).

molv.description: Minimum order line value for this supplier — supplier-wide, not per-warehouse.

moq.description: Minimum order quantity for this supplier — informational (see constraint.schema.json kind MIN_QTY), never silently changes price. Supplier-wide, not per-warehouse.

warehouses.description: Per-destination-warehouse landed-cost charges this supplier bills, keyed by warehouse code (e.g. "US01", "EU01", "CN01", "IN01") — matches an item's `warehouse` field. A warehouse this supplier doesn't ship to simply has no entry; the line then falls back to whatever API6 already put in facts.elements for freight/duty/tariff, same as a supplier with no override at all.
